description: This file defines a class 'BstoreContainer' that manages a collection of BLIP Store Entries (BSE), which are likely image or picture elements in a drawing or graphics context. The class provides methods to add BSE objects and retrieve the collection.

classes.name: BstoreContainer
classes.description: A container class managing a collection of BSE (Big Large Image or Picture) objects, providing methods to add and retrieve these entries.

methods.name: addBSE
methods.description: Adds a BSE object to the collection and sets its parent to this container.

methods.name: getBSECollection
methods.description: Returns the array of all BSE objects stored in this container.
